mapper.select:
SELECT ID, REC_VER, CONTENT FROM sys_notice WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND TYPE = 'ANNOUNCEMENT' AND EFFECTIVE_TIME_FROM IS NULL AND EFFECTIVE_TIME_TO IS NULL
union all
SELECT ID, REC_VER, CONTENT FROM sys_notice WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND TYPE = 'ANNOUNCEMENT' AND EFFECTIVE_TIME_FROM IS NOT NULL AND EFFECTIVE_TIME_TO IS NOT NULL and NOW() BETWEEN EFFECTIVE_TIME_FROM AND EFFECTIVE_TIME_TO
UNION ALL
SELECT ID, REC_VER, CONTENT FROM sys_notice WHERE 1 = 1 AND LOGIC_DEL = 0 AND TYPE = 'ANNOUNCEMENT' and EFFECTIVE_TIME_FROM IS NOT NULL AND EFFECTIVE_TIME_TO IS NULL AND NOW() >= EFFECTIVE_TIME_FROM
